subject: planner: introduce a new fix-control 43817 to control whether to allow the optimizer to evaluate non-correlated sub-queries in advance (#53782)
summary: Adds fix-control `43817` (`tidb_opt_fix_control`) that, when enabled, makes planner-time evaluation of non-correlated subqueries (`plannercore.EvalSubqueryFirstRow`, implemented in `pkg/executor/executor.go`) return a specific error instead of executing the subquery during optimization; includes a new integration test to validate on/off behavior.
